changes.text: Telegram is a notification destination: a bot token, a chat ID and an optional topic ID
Telegram sends the poster with media added and upgraded notifications
ntfy, Gotify, Pushover and Telegram open the media page from a media notification
Gotify and ntfy builtin priorities follow the event severity on the Priority select's scale
server back online no longer bypasses Pushover quiet hours
downloads are tracked on Plex, Jellyfin and Emby, with a Downloads tab under Stats and on each user
an automation can fire when a person downloads more than N items in a window
converted downloads are tracked: Plex and Emby app downloads with delivered quality, Jellyfin pulls with the plugin
SSE plugin 0.6.0 reports downloads immediately; older plugins are polled every 30 seconds
